summary: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, declaring monthly distributions for its common stock classes (I, D, T, S). Gross distribution per share is $0.0770; net after stockholder servicing fees ranges from $0.0770 (Class I) to $0.0632 (Classes T and S). Record date is April 30, 2026, payable on or about May 5, 2026, in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine distribution declaration, not a special situation.
